description.narrative: The project will help Chile meet its HCFC reduction targets under the Montreal Protocol and achieve complete phase out by 2030. Under the first tranche of the project, the following activities will be undertaken: Conduct six training courses on good refrigeration practices, refrigerant recovery and recycling, and safe use of alternative refrigerants for 90 RAC technicians; complete the module for one self-learning online course on best refrigeration practices; sign agreements with five training centres to support training of technicians; develop and implement labour competence standards in good refrigeration service practices for women technicians and support for 20 women for training and certification; identify two end-users for the Zero Leaks programme demonstration, and conduct one training course for 20 end users; initiate procurement of equipment for the reclamation centres; and project monitoring. The project is jointly implemented with UNEP as cooperating implementing agency.
